source.title: Ulmus - Grove Keeper
source.name: Ulmus
source.description: A resilient Tank who can withstand attacks and become more offensive in battle.

skills.name: Ancient Tenacity

description.raw: Passive. When Ulmus' HP ratio drops below 30% for the first time, he retreats to the backline and takes root to recover 30% (HP-based) + 2% (SP-based) HP. When rooted, Ulmus is Unaffected and unable to move. His normal attacks become ranged and deal an additional 50% damage to enemies surrounding the primary target. Active. Ulmus attacks an enemy, knocking the target and adjacent enemies into the air, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage plus an extra 4% (HP-based) damage. This skill prioritizes the area with the most enemies within his attack range.

skills.name: Verdant Barrier

description.raw: Ulmus gains a 25% (HP-based) + 3% (SP-based) shield that lasts 10s. When the shield breaks, it deals 160% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to surrounding enemies. If Ulmus is rooted, he will grant the shield to the frontmost ally instead.

skills.name: Way of the Forest

description.raw: Passive. Ulmus recovers 3.5% + 0.5% (SP-based) of his lost HP per second. When rooted, he will instead recover 30 + 4 (SP-based) Energy per second.

skills.name: Prowling Roots

description.raw: Ulmus extends his roots to trap vulnerable enemies on the battlefield. Whenever an enemy target is knocked down, knocked into the air or affected by other displacement effects, Ulmus binds the target to the ground, increasing the knockdown duration by 2 and dealing 80% (ATK-based) damage. This effect can only affect the same enemy once every 10s.
